newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal shares lose momentum, Portucel shines.
newsitem.headline: Portugal shares lose momentum, Portucel shines.

text.p: Shares ended slightly softer overall as the weakness in foreign bourses outweighed local factors such as the Bank of Portugal rate cut, traders said. Futures ended weaker than the cash market.
*The short-term outlook is dependent on what happens to New York where the market was falling on renewed interest rate fears.
*"We are going to have to wait and see how New York closes. The (local) market has all the ingredients to rise but the mood abroad is not very favourable and investors are cautious," said one dealer.

*Pulp producer Portucel closed strongly in heavy trade of over 500,000 shares, with non-residents behind the buying. Traders said that the better outlook for the sector, particularly in the United States, had encouraged some interest.
*"The S&P (Standard & Poor's) index for pulp has performed well and perhaps some U.S. investors have decided to invest in the sector," said one trader.
